# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 44 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)

**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 38 | **Source Image:** source-texts/coptic/GTH_044_page_001.jpg

---

## Saying 44

**1** Jesus said: "Anyone who speaks against the Father will be forgiven. Anyone who speaks against the Son will be forgiven.

**2** But anyone who speaks against the Holy Spirit — that will not be forgiven, in this world or in the next."

---

**Translation Notes (PNEUMA):**
- "Speaks against" — blasphemy rendered in more accessible terms
- "In this world or in the next" — "on earth or in heaven" rendered as temporal/cosmological spheres
